commit.message:
prompts: linux: add Chinese documentation maintainer notes

Add a maintainer note for patches that touch
Documentation/translations/zh_CN/. It records the translation policy
that cannot be derived from the source: translation-only scope, the
English source and tracking fields, the commit reference that
checktransupdate follows, line and heading width, RST labels and
builds, checkpatch and the mail flow, and the boundary between
translation defects worth reporting and wording preferences that are
not.

The note is selected by the zh_CN directory prefix, with one rule per
bullet as the maintainer guide asks. No Rust code, code notes
profile, or mailing list configuration changes.

Signed-off-by: Zixin Wang <w1355457260@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Chao Liu <chao.liu@processmission.com>

prompts: linux: scope zh_CN note rules to observable evidence

Scope the commit-message and header rules to the applicable commit
type, make the proofreader field optional, and state the line-width
limit in Chinese characters rather than raw characters.

Replace requirements that depend on unobservable contributor steps
(build logs, Documentation/output inspection, checkpatch, mail
delivery, mailing-list concurrency) with reporting only issues
visible in the patch, and allow single-file translations.

Signed-off-by: Zixin Wang <w1355457260@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Chao Liu <chao.liu@processmission.com>
